stories.h: Boeing 737 MAX deliveries hit lowest month in a year
stories.s: Boeing delivered 32 MAX jets in October and will miss its 500-delivery goal for 2026. Its Renton wing shop is struggling to keep pace, pushing 47-a-month production to early 2027.

stories.h: King County weighs more courthouse security after attacks
stories.s: More than 50 incidents this year, including a juror attacked nearby, were discussed at a council committee. Councilmember Balducci, who was grabbed outside the courthouse, wants the 4th Avenue entrance reopened.

stories.h: Suspect in Coast Guard officer's Skyway killing posts bail
stories.s: Isaiah Bolar, 18, charged with murder in the August shooting of Lt. Connor Overstreet, was released after posting $3 million bail. The victim's family says it is shocked by the bail system.

stories.h: Man accused of cutting deputy skips court after bail
stories.s: Daniel McCullough, charged after a deputy was cut during an arrest in Shoreline, posted $25,000 bail and then missed his arraignment. A judge issued a warrant and raised bail to $150,000.

coming.h: Garth Brooks plays four Climate Pledge Arena shows
coming.s: Shows run Thursday through Sunday. Saturday is sold out, and tickets for the other nights start at $155.

coming.h: WildLanterns opens at Woodland Park Zoo
coming.s: The holiday lantern show runs 4 to 9 p.m. daily through Jan. 17. Adult tickets start at $35.

coming.h: Seattle International Auto Show at Lumen Field
coming.s: The show runs Friday through Sunday at the Lumen Field Event Center. Single-day tickets are about $18 to $20.
